localContext: Hoffman Estates homes, built largely between the 1960s and 1980s, often have original wood-composite garage doors. These doors are showing their age. Water exposure is common in areas like South Ridge and Highlands. The northwest-corridor terrain here directs horizontal rain and snow straight at west-facing garages. This weather causes door panels to swell and delaminate. This stress on the door panels also stresses the tracks. Tracks can bend or loosen when heavy, warped door sections force them out of alignment. Rollers might jump the track, or the door binds in the same spot. We see this issue often with older doors around Hoffman Estates. Addressing track damage prevents more costly repairs later.
